Slop To-do · free, in your browser

A free online to-do list, no sign-up

Type a task and press Enter. Give it a due date and time, a list, tags, subtasks or a repeat when you need to, and see at a glance what is due Today and what is Upcoming.

Open Slop To-do

How to do it

  1. Open Slop To-do, type in Add a task and press Enter.
  2. Press Details… (or open a task) to set the Due date, Due time, Priority, List, Tags, Repeat and Reminder.
  3. Add subtasks inside a task and tick them off as you go.
  4. Switch between Today, Upcoming, All and your lists, and use Find to search.
  5. Tick a task to complete it. A repeating task moves on to its next date instead.

Your files stay on this device: Slop To-do runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Do I need an account?

No. Slop To-do opens in your browser and keeps your tasks on this device, with nothing uploaded.

Can tasks show on a calendar?

Yes. A task with a due time appears in Slop Calendar, and completing it in either app updates both.

Does it sync between devices?

No. Tasks are stored in this browser only, so a phone and a computer each keep their own list.

Can I get a reminder?

Yes: at the due time, or 15 minutes, 1 hour or 1 day before. It pops up while Slop To-do, Calendar or Reminders is open, and as a browser notification if you allow it.
